title: Cow dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dance floor glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='38' ry='7' fill='#4a2a6a' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- cow body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='22' ry='17' fill='#f0f0f5'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='55' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='65' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='50' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  
  <!-- legs - dancing pose -->
  <!-- back left leg -->
  <rect x='34' y='72' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f0f0f5'/>
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='87' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <!-- back right leg (lifted) -->
  <rect x='44' y='72' width='6' height='10' rx='3' fill='#f0f0f5' transform='rotate(-30 47 72)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='81' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <!-- front left leg (lifted) -->
  <rect x='58' y='72' width='6' height='10' rx='3' fill='#f0f0f5' transform='rotate(25 61 72)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='80' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <!-- front right leg -->
  <rect x='60' y='72' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#f0f0f5'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='87' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#f0f0f5'/>
  <!-- head spot -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='32' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='36' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f0f0f5' transform='rotate(-20 34 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='36' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f0f0f5' transform='rotate(20 66 36)'/>
  <!-- ear inner -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='36' rx='3' ry='1.5' fill='#e8a0b0' transform='rotate(-20 34 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='36' rx='3' ry='1.5' fill='#e8a0b0' transform='rotate(20 66 36)'/>
  
  <!-- horns -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='26' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#f5d76e'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='26' rx='2.5' ry='4' fill='#f5d76e'/>
  
  <!-- eyes - happy dancing -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='38' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#1a1040'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='38' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#1a1040'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#f5c0c8'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='46' rx='1.5' ry='1.2' fill='#d08090'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='46' rx='1.5' ry='1.2' fill='#d08090'/>
  
  <!-- happy open mouth -->
  <path d='M46 50 Q50 54 54 50' stroke='#d08090' stroke-width='1.5' fill='#c06070' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- smile lines -->
  <path d='M38 44 Q40 47 42 46' stroke='#d0a0a8' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 44 Q60 47 58 46' stroke='#d0a0a8' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 60 Q80 55 82 48' stroke='#f0f0f5' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='83' cy='46' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  
  <!-- udder -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#f5c0c8'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='75' r='1.5' fill='#e8a0b0'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='76' r='1.5' fill='#e8a0b0'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='75' r='1.5' fill='#e8a0b0'/>
  
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#ffdd55'>
    <ellipse cx='22' cy='30' rx='3' ry='2.5'/>
    <rect x='24' y='18' width='1.5' height='12'/>
    <path d='M24 18 Q28 16 28 20' stroke='#ffdd55' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#66ddaa'>
    <ellipse cx='78' cy='25' rx='2.5' ry='2'/>
    <rect x='79.5' y='15' width='1.2' height='10'/>
    <path d='M79.5 15 Q83 13 83 17' stroke='#66ddaa' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- star sparkles -->
  <path d='M18 50 L20 48 L22 50 L20 52 Z' fill='#ffdd55'/>
  <path d='M80 55 L82 53 L84 55 L82 57 Z' fill='#ff88aa'/>
  <path d='M25 70 L26 68 L27 70 L26 72 Z' fill='#66ddaa'/>
</svg>
